What's New in TK-mac

We’ve squashed bugs and added improvements to keep your Mac running smoothly.

  • 📊 System Memory Sampling Fixed: Resolved an issue where RAM usage for system processes was not displaying during sampling. You can now accurately track memory usage for all processes.
  • 🗑️ Safer Uninstallations: When uninstalling applications, they are now safely moved to your Mac's Trash rather than being permanently deleted immediately.
  • ✨ UI Polish & Bug Fixes: Refined dashboard visual elements for a cleaner native experience, and squashed several under-the-hood bugs to improve overall app stability.
  • 🖥️ Desktop Power Status Fixed: Resolved an issue where iMacs and other desktop Macs displayed incorrect battery stats. They will now correctly show as running on a Power Adapter in System Info.
  • 🛡️ Advanced Firewall Safety: Completely rebuilt the firewall engine to be dynamic and crash-proof. It now perfectly remembers your settings and guarantees your internet is never accidentally blocked when you quit the app.

Thank you for your continued feedback, which helps us make TK-mac the best it can be.
